fundamental.summary: EEM shows no fundamental conviction signals—zero insider activity, no institutional positioning, no government contracts, no lobbying, and minimal retail interest; insufficient data for directional bias.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (342.24) dominates risk assessment; normal yield curve and flat DXY provide minimal offset to acute market stress environment.

debate.key_bull_argument: Short-term momentum (EMA alignment, MACD crossover, Supertrend bullish) with extreme fear sentiment (28/100) creates contrarian entry opportunity near support at 43.65.
